item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-12
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Oura Ring users may get in-app access to real doctors soon – what we know
Oura’s acquisition of Counsel Health could signal a new dawn for digital care.

2. [Tech News] Claude can collaborate in your team meetings soon – like an intern
Claude is responding ‘Yes’ to that calendar invite – with some limitations. Plus: Anthropic launches two more new features that are available now.

3. [Tech News] OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

4. [Tech News] The Download: COP31’s climate challenge and the quest for immortality
This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. What to know about this year’s UN climate talks Thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists have gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31

5. [Tech News] The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
